 
 
# fitting longitudinal Cog ~ biomarkers model 

```{r}
m_ptau <- lmer(
  cdrsb ~ log_ptau217 * time + sex + age_at_ptau + years_education + 
    (1 + time | subject_label),
  data = cog_dat
)
m_tau <- lmer(
  cdrsb ~ desikan_suvr * time + sex + age_at_ptau + years_education + 
    (1 + time | subject_label),
  data = cog_dat
)
m_cl <- lmer(
  cdrsb ~ centiloid_wcbl * time + sex + age_at_ptau + years_education + 
    (1 + time | subject_label),
  data = cog_dat
)
m_full <- lmer(
  cdrsb ~ 
    log_ptau217 * time +
    desikan_suvr * time +
    centiloid_wcbl * time + sex + age_at_ptau + years_education + 
    (1 + time | subject_label),
  data = cog_dat
)
```
 
# extract raw interaction term coeff, p value, standardized coeff 
```{R result extract}
library(broom.mixed) 
library(tibble)

# --- total N ---
n_rows <- nrow(cog_dat)
n_subj <- dplyr::n_distinct(cog_dat$subject_label)

n_tbl <- tibble(
  n_rows = n_rows,
  n_subjects = n_subj
)

# --- helper to extract both raw + standardized ---
extract_interaction_full <- function(fit, label) {

  raw <- broom.mixed::tidy(fit, effects = "fixed") %>%
    filter(grepl(":", term) & grepl("time", term)) %>%
    dplyr::select(term, estimate, p.value)

  std <- parameters::standardize_parameters(fit, method = "posthoc") %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    rename(term = Parameter) %>%
    filter(grepl(":", term) & grepl("time", term)) %>%
    dplyr::select(term, Std_Coefficient)

  raw %>%
    left_join(std, by = "term") %>%
    mutate(model = label) %>%
    dplyr::select(model, term,
           beta_raw = estimate,
           beta_std = Std_Coefficient,
           p = p.value)
}

# --- apply to all models ---
res_tbl <- bind_rows(
  extract_interaction_full(m_ptau, "pTau"),
  extract_interaction_full(m_tau,  "Tau"),
  extract_interaction_full(m_cl,   "Centiloid"),
  extract_interaction_full(m_full, "Full")
)

# --- add N ---
final_tbl <- res_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    n_rows = n_rows,
    n_subjects = n_subj
  )

final_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(beta_raw, beta_std, p), ~ round(.x,3))
  )
```

# semi partial r (by subtraction)
```{r}
 

# full model
m_full <- lmer(
  cdrsb ~ 
    log_ptau217 * time +
    desikan_suvr * time +
    centiloid_wcbl * time +
    (1 + time | subject_label),
  data = cog_dat
)

# remove each interaction term one at a time
m_no_ptau <- update(m_full, . ~ . - log_ptau217:time)
m_no_tau  <- update(m_full, . ~ . - desikan_suvr:time)
m_no_cl   <- update(m_full, . ~ . - centiloid_wcbl:time)

# marginal R²
r2_full    <- r2(m_full)$R2_marginal
r2_no_ptau <- r2(m_no_ptau)$R2_marginal
r2_no_tau  <- r2(m_no_tau)$R2_marginal
r2_no_cl   <- r2(m_no_cl)$R2_marginal

# contribution
tibble(
  term = c("pTau:time", "Tau:time", "CL:time"),
  delta_R2 = c(
    round(r2_full - r2_no_ptau,3),
    round(r2_full - r2_no_tau,3),
    round(r2_full - r2_no_cl,3)
  )
)
```


# plot marginal effect plot 
```{r}   


# --- helper: better shading ---
three_shades <- function(base_col) {
  c(
    lighten(base_col, 0.4),
    base_col,
    darken(base_col, 0.4)
  )
}

# --- base colors per biomarker ---
color_map <- c(
  centiloid_wcbl_bl = "#2ca25f",
  log_ptau_bl       = "#3182bd",
  desikan_suvr_bl   = "#e6550d"
)

pretty_lab <- c(
  log_ptau_bl       = "log(p-tau)",
  centiloid_wcbl_bl = "Centiloid",
  desikan_suvr_bl   = "Cortical tau"
)

# --- shading lookup (per biomarker) ---
shade_df <- map_dfr(names(color_map), function(bm) {
  cols <- three_shades(color_map[[bm]])
  
  tibble(
    biomarker = bm,
    z_level = factor(c("−1 SD", "Mean", "+1 SD"),
                     levels = c("−1 SD", "Mean", "+1 SD")),
    col = cols
  )
})

# --- marginal effect function ---
make_marginal_effect_df <- function(d,
                                    biomarker,
                                    timevar = "time_yrs",
                                    id = "subject_label",
                                    outcome = "cdrsb",
                                    covars = NULL,
                                    REML = FALSE) {

  covars <- covars %||% character(0)

  dd <- d %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(c(outcome, id, timevar, biomarker, covars))) %>%
    drop_na()

  biom_z <- paste0(biomarker, "_z")
  dd[[biom_z]] <- scale(dd[[biomarker]])[,1]

  fml <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      outcome, " ~ ",
      biom_z, " * ", timevar,
      if (length(covars) > 0) paste0(" + ", paste(covars, collapse = " + ")) else "",
      " + (1 + ", timevar, " | ", id, ")"
    )
  )

  fit <- lmerTest::lmer(fml, data = dd, REML = REML)

  pred <- ggpredict(
    fit,
    terms = c(paste0(timevar, " [all]"), paste0(biom_z, " [-1,0,1]"))
  ) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rename(
      time_yrs = x,
      pred = predicted,
      lo = conf.low,
      hi = conf.high
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      biomarker = biomarker,
      z_level = factor(group,
                       levels = c("-1", "0", "1"),
                       labels = c("−1 SD", "Mean", "+1 SD"))
    )

  list(fit = fit, pred_df = pred)
}

# --- prepare data ---
df_long_filtered <- cog_dat %>%
  rename(
    log_ptau_bl = log_ptau217,
    centiloid_wcbl_bl = centiloid_wcbl,
    desikan_suvr_bl = desikan_suvr,
    time_yrs = time
  )

biomarkers <- c("log_ptau_bl", "centiloid_wcbl_bl", "desikan_suvr_bl")

# --- run models ---
res_list <- map(
  biomarkers,
  ~ make_marginal_effect_df(
    d = df_long_filtered,
    biomarker = .x,
    timevar = "time_yrs",
    id = "subject_label",
    outcome = "cdrsb",
    covars = c("age_at_ptau","sex","years_education"),
    REML = FALSE
  )
)

# --- combine predictions ---
pred_long <- map_dfr(res_list, "pred_df") %>%
  left_join(shade_df, by = c("biomarker", "z_level")) %>%
  mutate(
    biomarker_lab = factor(
      biomarker,
      levels = biomarkers,
      labels = pretty_lab[biomarkers]
    ),
    group_key = paste(biomarker, z_level)
  )

# --- color lookup per biomarker + level ---
color_lookup <- shade_df %>%
  mutate(key = paste(biomarker, z_level))

# --- final plot ---
pp <- ggplot(
  pred_long,
  aes(x = time_yrs, y = pred, group = group_key, color = group_key)
) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi, fill = group_key),
    alpha = 0.18,
    colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ biomarker_lab) +
  scale_color_manual(values = setNames(color_lookup$col, color_lookup$key)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(color_lookup$col, color_lookup$key)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 4), ylim = c(0, 18)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "years from baseline",
    y = "Longitudinal cdrsb"
  )

pp
 
```
